title: 实现工作与摸鱼模式
constraints: Use real Codex Luna Developer and Codex Sol Reviewer; never use Mock.
Do not implement Phase 3 or prohibited systems such as real ads, backend, friends, rankings, store, skins, payments or cloud saves.
Do not claim Cocos Editor validation unless the Editor is actually launched.
All state changes must go through services and critical save failures must not leave memory ahead of persistence.

Architecture adjudication: persist separate weighted fixed-point remainders for salary, cultivation and mind so rate changes and reloads preserve exact accumulation. SaveService must cache and expose the most recent successful committed snapshot shared by all services; WorkService rollback must use that snapshot without a new storage read and preserve the original write error.
goal: 实现 WorkMode WORK/FISHING 的在线 tick 结算，更新工资、修为、道心及累计秒数。
background: Phase 2 sequential task TASK-025; depends on TASK-024 being DONE, except TASK-020 which depends on Phase 1.1 PASS.
requirements: WORK 工资/修为100%且消耗道心；FISHING 工资/修为50%且恢复道心。
模式切换保存，不使用后台 Timer 或每帧保存。
